summary:
Complete implementation of the Account Suspension Scheduler and Reason Management for St. Cecilia's College.
Features include admin suspension controls with presets (1h, 24h, 3d, 7d, 15d, 30d, custom), mandatory explanation with institutional templates, automatic background and on-login expiration restoration to ACTIVE, immediate session token revocation, comprehensive activity log classifications with ⚠️ warnings, and user-facing collegiate suspension notice modals. All 10 test suites and 89 unit tests pass.
